digo: mgomba / mndizi (plant; Pakia: mgomba N, mkoo S); izu / ndizi (fruit)

teaser.en: Digo farmers grow some twenty-five kinds of banana, with names like 'elephant's hand' and 'arrow'.
teaser.sw: Wakulima Wadigo hupanda takriban aina ishirini na tano za ndizi, zenye majina kama 'mkono wa tembo' na 'mshale'.
teaser.dg: Akurima a Chidigo anarima aina phephi makumi mairi na tsano za ndizi, zenye madzina dza 'mkpwono wa ndzovu' na 'mshale'.

summary.en: *Mgomba* or *mndizi* is the banana plant, grown in wet hollows and homestead gardens all over Digo country. It feeds families both as cooking banana stewed in coconut milk and as sweet ripe fruit.
summary.sw: *Mgomba* au *mndizi* ni mmea wa ndizi, unaopandwa katika mabonde yenye unyevu na bustani za maboma kote katika nchi ya Wadigo. Hulisha familia kama ndizi za kupika zilizopikwa kwa tui la nazi na pia kama tunda tamu lililoiva.
summary.dg: *Mgomba* au *mndizi* ni mmea wa ndizi, unaophandwa kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kpwa minda ya midzi kosi kpwa tsi ya Adigo. Unarisa mbari dza ndizi za kujita zinazojitwa kpwa huwi, na dza matunda ga mtswano gachiivwa.

about.en:
Although it can be taller than a house, the banana is not a tree but a giant herb. What looks like a trunk is a tight roll of leaf bases, and from the top spring huge, paddle-shaped leaves that the wind tears into ribbons. Each plant flowers once: a long stalk pushes out of the centre and hangs down, carrying hands of fruit above a big purplish-red bud.

Digo has words for these parts: *humba* is the flower stalk and *tsupha* the red bud. The plant comes in many forms, and Digo farmers name around twenty-five cultivars, among them *chisukari*, *gojozi*, *mkono wa tembo*, *mshale*, *matoke*, *bokoboko* and *chibungale*.
about.sw:
Ingawa unaweza kuwa mrefu kuliko nyumba, mgomba si mti bali ni mmea mkubwa mno usio na shina la mbao. Kinachoonekana kama shina ni mkunjo mkaza wa vitako vya majani, na juu yake huchipuka majani makubwa mno yenye umbo la kasia ambayo upepo huyararua kuwa vipande. Kila mmea huchanua mara moja tu: kikonyo kirefu huchomoza kutoka katikati na kuning'inia chini, kikibeba matana ya ndizi juu ya ua kubwa la rangi ya zambarau-nyekundu.

Kidigo kina maneno kwa sehemu hizi: *humba* ni kikonyo cha maua na *tsupha* ni ua jekundu. Mmea huu una aina nyingi, na wakulima Wadigo hutaja takriban aina ishirini na tano, miongoni mwake *chisukari*, *gojozi*, *mkono wa tembo*, *mshale*, *matoke*, *bokoboko* na *chibungale*.
about.dg:
Hata kala unaweza kukala mure kuriko nyumba, mgomba si muhi ela ni mmea mkulu usio na nyama za muhi. Chinachoonekana dza kolo ni milita ya makodza iriyozunguluka phamwenga kpwa kubanana, na kula dzulu kunatuluka makodza makulu sana ga umbo ra kasia, ambago phepho inagaahula vipande-vipande. Chila mmea unatuluza maruwa mara mwenga bahi: mlita mure unatuluka kula kahi na kubwadzika photsi, uchitsukula matana ga ndizi dzulu ya tsupha kulu ra rangi ya kundu na zambarau.

Chidigo china maneno ga seemu hizi: *humba* ni mlita wa maruwa na *tsupha* ni tsupha ra kundu. Mmea uhu una maumbo manji, na akurima a Chidigo anataja aina phephi makumi mairi na tsano, kahi yao *chisukari*, *gojozi*, *mkono wa tembo*, *mshale*, *matoke*, *bokoboko* na *chibungale*.

where.en: Bananas need water, so on the south coast they are planted in wet hollows and in homestead gardens close to the house, where they are tended and watered. A clump of *migomba* is one of the surest signs of a lived-in compound.
where.sw: Migomba huhitaji maji, kwa hivyo katika pwani ya kusini hupandwa katika mabonde yenye unyevu na katika bustani za maboma karibu na nyumba, ambako hutunzwa na kumwagiliwa. Kichaka cha *migomba* ni mojawapo ya ishara za uhakika zaidi za boma linalokaliwa.
where.dg: Migomba inahitaji madzi, kpwa hivyo kpwa pwani ya kusini nkuphandwa kpwa madete ga madzi-madzi na kpwa minda ya midzi phephi na nyumba, ambako nkutundzwa na kutiywa madzi. Chitsaka cha *migomba* ni mwenga wa ishara za kpweli kabisa kukala mudzi una atu.

uses.en:
Cooking bananas are stewed in coconut milk, one of the everyday dishes of the coast, while dessert varieties are eaten ripe. Bananas are also used to make *mabumbunda*, a banana bread.

Nothing is wasted. The broad leaves serve as wrappers for food.
uses.sw:
Ndizi za kupika hupikwa kwa tui la nazi, mojawapo ya vyakula vya kila siku vya pwani, huku aina za kitindamlo huliwa zikiwa zimeiva. Ndizi pia hutumika kutengeneza *mabumbunda*, mkate wa ndizi.

Hakuna kinachopotea bure. Majani mapana hutumika kufungia chakula.
uses.dg:
Ndizi za kujita nkujitwa kpwa huwi, mwenga wa vyakurya vya chila siku vya pwani, na aina za mtswano nkuriwa zichiivwa. Ndizi piya nkuhumirwa kuhenda *mabumbunda*, mkahe wa ndizi.

Takuna chinachotsuphwa. Makodza mapana nkuhumirwa kufungira chakurya.

culture.en: The banana's name divides the Digo: northern speakers call the plant *mgomba*, while southern speakers call it *mkoo*. It is one of the clearest north and south differences in the Digo plant vocabulary.
culture.sw: Jina la mgomba huwagawa Wadigo: wazungumzaji wa kaskazini huuita mmea huu *mgomba*, huku wazungumzaji wa kusini wakiuita *mkoo*. Hii ni mojawapo ya tofauti zilizo wazi zaidi kati ya kaskazini na kusini katika msamiati wa mimea wa Kidigo.
culture.dg: Dzina ra mgomba rinaganya Adigo: ario kazikazini anauiha mmea *mgomba*, ela ario kusini anauiha *mkoo*. Hino ni mwenga wa tafwauti zinazoonekana wazi zaidi kahi ya kazikazini na kusini kpwa maneno ga mimea ga Chidigo.

names.en: The plant is *mgomba* or *mndizi*; one source gives *mgomba* for the north and *mkoo* for the south. The fruit is *izu* (plural *mazu*) or *ndizi*. Swahili uses *mgomba* or *mndizi* for the plant and *ndizi* for the fruit. In English it is the banana, or plantain for the cooking kinds.
names.sw: Mmea ni *mgomba* au *mndizi*; chanzo kimoja kinatoa *mgomba* kwa kaskazini na *mkoo* kwa kusini. Tunda ni *izu* (wingi *mazu*) au *ndizi*. Kiswahili hutumia *mgomba* au *mndizi* kwa mmea na *ndizi* kwa tunda. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *banana*, au *plantain* kwa aina za kupika.
names.dg: Mmea ni *mgomba* au *mndizi*; chandzo chimwenga chinapha *mgomba* kpwa kazikazini na *mkoo* kpwa kusini. Tunda ni *izu* (wingi *mazu*) au *ndizi*. Chiswahili chinahumira *mgomba* au *mndizi* kpwa mmea na *ndizi* kpwa tunda. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *banana*, au *plantain* kpwa aina za kujita.

reason.en: Its milk is what cooking bananas are stewed in
reason.sw: Tui lake ndilo linalotumika kupika ndizi
reason.dg: Huwire ndiro ndizi za kujita nkujitwa naro

reason.en: Another starchy staple cooked in coconut milk
reason.sw: Chakula kingine kikuu chenye wanga kinachopikwa kwa tui la nazi
reason.dg: Chakurya chanjina cha wanga chinachojitwa kpwa huwi

reason.en: Another homestead food plant important in lean times
reason.sw: Mmea mwingine wa chakula wa bomani ulio muhimu nyakati za uhaba
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa chakurya wa midzi wa muhimu wakati wa shida

reason.en: Grown in the same moist homestead plots
reason.sw: Hupandwa katika vipande vilevile vya bomani vyenye unyevu
reason.dg: Unaphandwa kpwa minda ya madzi-madzi ya midzi

definition.en: The trunk-like stem of the banana plant, made of tightly rolled leaf bases. The same word is used for the banana leaf and for the flower bud.
definition.sw: Shina la mgomba linalofanana na shina la mti, linalotokana na vitako vya majani vilivyokunjwa kwa kubana. Neno hilohilo hutumika kwa jani la mgomba na kwa ua.
definition.dg: Kolo ra mgomba, rinarohendwa ni milita ya makodza iriyozunguluka phamwenga kpwa kubanana. Neno hiri hiri nkuhumirwa kpwa kodza ra mgomba na kpwa tsupha.

meaning.en: Gomba also means 'to speak', and there is a clan called Achina-gomba, but Pakia found no link to the plant.
meaning.sw: Gomba pia lina maana ya 'kusema', na kuna ukoo unaoitwa Achina-gomba, lakini Pakia hakupata uhusiano na mmea huu.
meaning.dg: *Gomba* piya rina mana ya 'kugomba', na kuna mbari inayoihwa Achina-gomba, ela Pakia kaphaha uhusiano na mmea.

parts.english: pseudo-stem; also leaf and flower bud

definition.en: A young banana leaf. Its pale colour gives a Digo colour term for pale green.
definition.sw: Jani changa la mgomba. Rangi yake hafifu inatoa neno la Kidigo la rangi ya kijani hafifu.
definition.dg: Kodza tsanga ra mgomba. Rangiye ya chijani-ereru ndiyo inayopha Chidigo neno ra rangi ya chijani chereru.

definition.en: The stalk that sticks out from the plant and carries the developing bananas.
definition.sw: Kikonyo kinachochomoza kutoka mmea na kubeba ndizi zinazokua.
definition.dg: Mlita unaotuluka kula kpwa mmea na kutsukula ndizi zinazokula.

definition.en: The red cone that hangs from the stalk below the bananas and produces small flowers. Pakia notes that gomba is also used for the flower bud.
definition.sw: Koni nyekundu inayoning'inia kutoka kikonyo chini ya ndizi na kutoa maua madogo. Pakia anabainisha kwamba gomba pia hutumika kwa ua hilo.
definition.dg: Tsupha ra kundu rinarobwadzika kula kpwa mlita photsi ya ndizi na rinalavya maruwa madide. Pakia anagomba kukala *gomba* piya nkuhumirwa kpwa tsupha.

definition.en: Bananas, the fruit of the plant.
Banana; another Mgombato word for the fruit, alongside ndizi.
definition.sw: Ndizi; neno jingine la Mgombato kwa tunda hili, pamoja na ndizi.
definition.dg: Ndizi; neno ranjina ra Mgombato ra tunda hiri, phamwenga na *ndizi*.

definition.en: A single banana. Bananas are counted as 'fingers' (mala ga ndizi), as leaf lobes are; the same is said of similar-looking fruits of wild Uvaria species.
definition.sw: Ndizi moja. Ndizi huhesabiwa kama 'vidole' (mala ga ndizi), kama ilivyo kwa sehemu za jani; vivyo hivyo husemwa kuhusu matunda yanayofanana nayo ya spishi za porini za Uvaria.
definition.dg: Ndizi mwenga. Ndizi nkuolangbwa dza 'vyala' (*mala ga ndizi*), dza vira vyala vya kodza; vivyo hivyo nkugombwa kpwa matunda ganagohalana nago ga aina za weruni za *Uvaria*.

definition.en: A hand of bananas, one cluster of fingers on the stalk.
definition.sw: Tana la ndizi, kishada kimoja cha vidole kwenye kikonyo.
definition.dg: Tana ra ndizi, bunda rimwenga ra vyala kpwa mlita.

meaning.en: Tsana also means 'comb'; Pakia could not tell whether this is one word used for both or two words that sound alike.
meaning.sw: Tsana pia lina maana ya 'kitana'; Pakia hakuweza kubaini kama ni neno moja linalotumika kwa yote mawili au ni maneno mawili yanayosikika sawa.
meaning.dg: *Tsana* piya ni 'chitana' (cha kutsanira nyere); Pakia kaweza kumanya ichikala ni neno rimwenga ririro na mana mairi au ni maneno mairi ganagogombwa sawa.

definition.en: The whole bunch of bananas, all the hands on one stalk.
definition.sw: Mkungu mzima wa ndizi, matana yote kwenye kikonyo kimoja.
definition.dg: Bunda rosi ra ndizi, matana gosi kpwa mlita mmwenga.

definition.en: A banana sucker, the young shoot from the base used to plant a new banana. Pakia lists it among the named kinds of planting material (mbeyu).
definition.sw: Chipukizi la mgomba, mche mchanga kutoka kitakoni unaotumika kupanda mgomba mpya. Pakia analiorodhesha miongoni mwa aina za mbegu za kupanda zenye majina (mbeyu).
definition.dg: Mwana wa mgomba, mutse unaotuluka kula photsi unaohumirwa kuphanda mgomba muphya. Pakia anauandika kahi ya aina za mbeyu zirizo na madzina.

shared_with: mwana: the female flower (young cob) of maize
